subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close, adopt, or replace the open conflicting cross-repo PR before allowing a fresh fix for this Telegram approval cleanup bug?
rationale: The source bug is clear and narrow, but an open cross-repo PR still carries closing syntax and is conflicting/stale, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Authorize a fresh narrow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork candidate and let a current-main fix target `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and real Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt and repair the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer rebase or recreate the open cross-repo branch, remove obsolete handler/doc churn, and gather real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Leave paused for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not queue repair work until the fork PR author refreshes the candidate and proof.

recommendation.title: Authorize a fresh narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork candidate and let a current-main fix target `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns the native approval lifecycle refactor and the active Telegram approval runtime that gumadeiras introduced.
